capabilities: Show today's Apple Calendar events in a right sidebar and as inline banners below daily notes
Add an event as a task under the Tasks heading of the daily note
Create and open a meeting note linked from the daily note
Sync calendar snapshots, dismissals, and meeting records across devices through vault files
Filter events by calendar or by Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams links
extras: Includes a bundled Swift helper (source in helper/CalendarHelper.swift) embedded in main.js that reads Apple Calendar through EventKit; it only reads events and requires macOS Calendar permission. Mobile devices never contact Apple Calendar and rely on a synced snapshot file, so device clocks must be set automatically.
problem: Obsidian cannot read Apple Calendar directly, so meetings have to be checked elsewhere and manually turned into tasks or notes.

relations.evidence: Macs read Apple Calendar and publish a vault snapshot.
